field_requirements.sector_id: nullable when not applicable; must resolve to a registered sector when present
field_requirements.entity_id: original entity identifier in the source domain
field_requirements.event_time: ISO-8601 with explicit time standard; null when not applicable
field_requirements.ingest_time: ISO-8601 with explicit time standard; never equal to an invented event time
field_requirements.source_id: must resolve to a source contract; null means unverified and non-promotable
field_requirements.payload: domain-typed object; never a free-text substitute for a measurement
field_requirements.units: must be in the declared unit vocabulary or explicitly null
field_requirements.coordinate_frame: CRS/datum reference or explicitly null; mixed frames require a transformation record
field_requirements.model_version: version of the producing model/algorithm or null
field_requirements.uncertainty: explicit interval/quality record or null; null is displayed as unknown, never as zero
field_requirements.permissions: privacy/licence/access scope record; required for cross-domain events

note: A contract, not a claim. Fields may be null when inapplicable; incompatible units, times, frames, evidence states and permissions may never be merged.
